audit.whatIsWrong: Three whys contradicted their own row: whys[0] said 'Level 1 is yours' while win[0] is Skill, whys[2] said 'favours you' while win[2] is Akali, whys[4] said 'Level 6 is yours' while win[4] is Skill.
audit.why: The chart row and its explanation render side by side; a reader sees two answers.
audit.corrected: whys[0], whys[2] and whys[4] rewritten to state the side their row actually holds. Sides themselves left alone — full and content already agree row for row.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on either ultimate.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is 120s at rank 1 and Primal Howl 15s at rank 1; those numbers make the windows concrete.
audit.corrected: Perfect Execution's 120s rank-1 cooldown in phases[4].why; Primal Howl's 1s fear named in tradeBad.

audit.whatIsWrong: TWO fabrications. (1) 'Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter' — it is a directional leap that suppresses the first champion it collides with. (2) 'Blood Hunt reveals her true position ... even inside her W' — Blood Hunt grants move speed toward and attack speed against sub-50% enemies and nothing else; it grants no vision and does not reveal through Twilight Shroud. The full layer also said shroud 'dodges your R', which contradicts the content layer.
audit.why: Riot's own text for Warwick W has no reveal component; his R text is a directional leap with collision. Untargetability stops targeted spells, not a collision leap, so shroud is not the answer the full layer claimed.
audit.corrected: R described as a collision leap that shroud's untargetability does not stop; the invented Blood Hunt reveal removed from spikes[1] and wants.you[2]; the full layer's 'dodges your R' line brought in line with the content layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Akali referred to as 'he' and 'his' throughout the trading lines; wants.foe[0] has the typo 'passsive'.
audit.why: Template bleed from a generic fill.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and real ability names used in tradeGood/tradeBad; typo removed.

edits.before: Level 1 is yours since Akali's energy and rank-1 E can't win a trade against your Q sustain.
edits.after: Level 1 is a coin flip: Five Point Strike pokes free, but Q sustain beats her rank-1 E trade.

edits.before: Level 3 favours you because your Q heal and W attack speed still out-trade her weak early all-in.
edits.after: Level 3 goes to Akali once Twilight Shroud is up — she farms untargetable and your Q needs a target.

edits.before: Level 6 is yours: R Infinite Duress suppresses through her shroud repositioning.
edits.after: Level 6 is even: Duress collides and suppresses, but Perfect Execution answers it.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akali's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is a directional leap that suppresses the first champion it hits — shroud does not stop it. Perfect Execution at 120s changes the math.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool — build your teamfight around that. Akali carry threat: 8.5/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is a directional leap that suppresses the first champion it collides with — build the fight around it. Akali carry threat: 8.5/10 — shift to picks and wave control if she gets ahead.

edits.before: Your R Infinite Duress locks her out of shroud repositioning — ult the instant she commits, and Blood Hunt reveals her true position when she's low even inside her W.
edits.after: Infinite Duress collides rather than targets, so Twilight Shroud's untargetability does not stop it — leap the instant she commits, and never spend it chasing her into the smoke.

edits.before: Use W reveal to track her through Twilight Shroud when she's low
edits.after: Leap R through the shroud — it collides, it does not target

edits.before: Farm safely with Q passsive and shroud until level 6 online
edits.after: Farm safely with Five Point Strike and shroud until level 6

edits.before: Untargetable inside it; dodges your R. Fight when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Untargetable inside it, but your R collides and still lands. Only engage once her energy is spent.

edits.before: Track Akali's Twilight Shroud: Untargetable inside it; dodges your R. Fight when down. When it is down — Q-bite + R her.
edits.after: Track Akali's Twilight Shroud: untargetable inside it, but Infinite Duress collides and still lands. When it is down — Q-bite + R.

edits.before: Q-bite Akali as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Q-bite Akali as she steps up (hold Q to follow Shuriken Flip), weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger out-heal her poke.

edits.before: Trading into his full burst window with E down — fear is your trade-flipper; without it you are just a sustain bot.
edits.after: Trading into her E-Q burst with Primal Howl down — the 1s fear is your trade-flipper; without it you are a sustain bot.

notes: Killed a fabricated mechanic: the entry claimed Blood Hunt reveals Akali's position inside Twilight Shroud. Riot's W text grants move speed toward and attack speed against sub-50% enemies only — no vision, no reveal. Also fixed the full layer's 'shroud dodges your R', which contradicted the content layer and the mirror; R is a collision leap, so untargetability does not answer it. Level chart left as-is: full and content already agree row for row, though the packet levelChart differs (see questions).
